head: 18550af88f665103e11c8e08d7c701118be1d156
scope: Read-only static production-source mapping after native diffuse/specular RR output. No game, build, GPU/native launch, or historical trace inspection performed.
finding: No reachable production consumer of native diffuse/specular output alpha was found. Normal/recovery/debug composition reads native RGB only and writes composition A=1. Raw RGBA blit exists, but its sole production caller does not bind either native lobe output.

references.claim: Native diffuse=m_outputBuffer2 and specular=m_outputBuffer1; separate composition target, all RGBA16F.
Normal composer t0/t2 bind native outputs; disabled signals select packed input instead. Detail/history are distinct resources.
Every native radiance read uses RGB; every nonblit OutColor write sets A=1, including recovery and composition diagnostics.
Alpha-dependent history predicates consume reference/motion/normal/decision alpha, not native lobe alpha.
Blit aliases arbitrary srcTex to t0 and enables RawSourceBlit|ScaleSrc. Native output getter definitions have no production callers.
RawSourceBlit copies/samples RGBA, so a future direct-native caller could propagate native A.

Actual sole production Blit caller selects separate AMD debug output, title resources, AO, conversion input signal or composition, never either native lobe output. Normal upscaler receives composition.
Each conversion freshly seeds scratch from title inputs before filter, buffer swaps, packing and RR; old native output A is not a next-frame Floor input.
Every current in-bounds seed output pixel gets new RGBA; zero with Floor disabled, current RGB/uncertainty with Floor enabled.
Floor alpha-dependent weights consume newly seeded uncertainty, not previous native output A.
Reactive/transparency resources are title masks or processed DLSS bias fallback; upscaler output is routed NGX output, not native lobes.
Additive selection changes conversion PSO only; same embedded output-composition shader is initialized.

limits: Static source confidence is high; no current-game verification.
Opaque AMD internals and emitted shader-blob/source equivalence were not independently verified by this mapping.
Preserved or unwritten native output alpha alone establishes neither an SDK bug nor a visible defect.
